{{Top|leg}}
'''Deflector emitters''' were used to power the deflector shield of spaceships such as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. One was added to the ''Falcon'' sometime around [[15 ABY/Legends|15 ABY]].
